いざ」
pages.jaRuby:
「
いざ」
pages.en: “—Come.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Let us.”

pages.ja:
そうして、剣士はその業物を構えた。
構えらしき物を持たぬアサシンの唯一の構え。
異なる円を描く刃を同時に放ち、敵を四散させる必殺剣。
それを彼女は体験している。
……以前放たれた刃は、敵を囲む円と縦軸しかなかった。
だからこそ彼女は避け、こうして命を繋いでいる。

pages.en:
And with that, the swordsman assumes his stance.

It is the sole stance of Assassin, who otherwise appears to possess none.

A killing sword that releases blades tracing separate circles at the same instant, tearing its victim asunder.

She has experienced it before.

…The blades unleashed on that occasion possessed only a circle enclosing the enemy and a vertical stroke.

That was the sole reason she escaped and remains alive now.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And the swordsman readies his sword.
The only stance for the man who does not have a stance.
A fatal technique that cuts his enemy by simultaneously executing blows from different angles.
She has experienced the move before.
…The previous one only had an arc to surround his enemy and a vertical slash.
That is why she was able to avoid it and live up to this day.

pages.ja:
だが、真のソレは三つの軌跡を持つという。
円を描く線と頭上から股下までを断つ縦の線。……そして恐らくは、左右に逃げる敵を捉える横の線。
この三つが同時に放たれるのならば逃げ場などない。
間合いに入ったが最後、一つの軌跡を受けた瞬間に二つの軌跡が体を四散させる。
左右にも逃れられず、後退したところで長刀は苦もなく逃げる胴を薙ぐだろう。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
But the true technique is said to contain three paths.

The circular stroke. The vertical stroke that cleaves from crown to groin. …And presumably, a horizontal stroke to catch an enemy fleeing to either side.

If all three are released simultaneously, no escape exists.

The moment one enters his reach, the instant one path strikes, the other two will dismember the body.

There is no flight to the left or right, while a retreating torso would be swept aside without effort by that long blade.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But the real technique has three slashes.
A circular slash and a vertical slash. …And probably a horizontal slash that cuts anyone that escapes sideways.
There is nowhere to run if the three attacks are executed all at once.
Once in range, the other two attacks will cut you even if one is blocked.
One cannot escape sideways, and the longsword will reach out even if one retreats.

pages.ja:
魔剣、燕返し。
サーヴァントすら凌駕する神域の技。
無名の剣士が、その存在全てを懸けて練り上げた究極の一が、ここにある。
pages.jaRuby:
魔剣、燕返し。
サーヴァントすら凌駕する神域の技。
無名の剣士が、その存在全てを懸けて練り上げた究極の一が、ここにある。
pages.en:
—The sorcerous sword, Tsubame Gaeshi.

A technique in the realm of the divine, surpassing even Servants.

Here stands the ultimate stroke, perfected by a nameless swordsman who staked the whole of his existence upon it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Demonic technique, Tsubame Gaeshi.
A godly technique that even surpasses the Servants.
The ultimate attack, perfected by an anonymous swordsman using all his life.

pages.ja:
長刀が揺れる。
その体が、一足で間合いを詰める。
セイバーを断ち切る距離、
あらゆる守りを許さぬ間合いから、牢獄の如き軌跡が繰り出される
！
pages.jaRuby:
長刀が揺れる。
その体が、一足で間合いを詰める。
セイバーを断ち切る距離、
あらゆる守りを許さぬ間合いから、牢獄の如き軌跡が繰り出される
！
pages.en:
The long sword stirs.

His body closes the distance in a single step.

He enters the range from which he can cut Saber down—

and from that distance, where every defense is forbidden, he releases three paths like the bars of a prison—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
The longsword trembles.
His body moves in with one step.
The distance to attack Saber.
Prison-like arcs are executed from a range that does not allow any defense!

pages.ja:
「
」
セイバーは聖剣を使わない。
もとより、この間合いになった時点で宝具など使えない。
いかにセイバーの聖剣が速かろうと、アサシンの燕返しは、それを遙かに上回る。
聖剣に魔力を籠めた時点で彼女の首は跳んでいる。
故に、頼りとなるのは純粋な剣技のみ。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」
セイバーは聖剣を使わない。
もとより、この間合いになった時点で宝具など使えない。
いかにセイバーの聖剣が速かろうと、アサシンの燕返しは、それを遙かに上回る。
聖剣に魔力を籠めた時点で彼女の首は跳んでいる。
故に、頼りとなるのは純粋な剣技のみ。
pages.en:
“——”

Saber does not use her holy sword.

From the moment she entered this range, there was never time to invoke a Noble Phantasm.

However swiftly Saber’s holy sword may strike, Assassin’s Tsubame Gaeshi surpasses it by far.

Her head would fly before she could finish pouring magical energy into the blade.

Therefore, she can rely upon nothing but pure swordsmanship.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Saber does not use her holy sword.
She cannot use her Noble Phantasm at this range.
No matter how fast Saber may be, Assassin’s Tsubame Gaeshi is many times faster.
Her neck will be cut the instant she puts magical energy into her sword.
Therefore, her only weapon is pure technique.

pages.ja:
円が走る。
二度目だというのにその鋭利さ、迅速さに感嘆し、絶望する。
このような一撃
果たして、如何なる修練の果てに辿り着くのかと。
pages.jaRuby:
円が走る。
二度目だというのにその鋭利さ、迅速さに感嘆し、絶望する。
このような一撃
果たして、如何なる修練の果てに辿り着くのかと。
pages.en:
—The circle races forth.

Though she has seen it once before, its keenness and speed fill her with both awe and despair.

What lifetime of discipline could ever lead a man to such a stroke—?
pages.mirrorMoon:
The blade begins its arcs.
She feels despair from its precision and speed.
Such an attack
how much training was needed to get this far?

pages.ja:
「
」
その時、彼女にあったものは戦慄だけだった。
防げるものではない。
この魔剣は、人の身で神仏に挑む修羅の業。
神ならぬ身では防ぐ事も返す事も許されまい。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」
その時、彼女にあったものは戦慄だけだった。
防げるものではない。
この魔剣は、人の身で神仏に挑む修羅の業。
神ならぬ身では防ぐ事も返す事も許されまい。
pages.en:
“——”

In that moment, she knows only terror.

This is not something that can be blocked.

This sorcerous blade is the deed of an asura who, though born human, would challenge gods and buddhas.

No being short of a god could be permitted to block or counter it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Fear is the only thing on her mind.
It cannot be blocked.
This technique is a technique of carnage that challenges God with mere human skill.
Only God would be able to block it.

pages.ja:
「は
」
息を呑む。
脳裏には砂粒ほどの微かな閃き。
それが何なのか、それが合っているのかなど考えない。
彼女は、ただ己が直感に全てを賭け、
「あ
！」
全能力を以って、その“勝利”へと疾走した。
pages.jaRuby:
「は
」
息を呑む。
脳裏には砂粒ほどの微かな閃き。
それが何なのか、それが合っているのかなど考えない。
彼女は、ただ己が直感に全てを賭け、
「あ
！」
全能力を以って、その“勝利”へと疾走した。
pages.en:
“Hah—”

Her breath catches.

A glimmer no larger than a grain of sand flashes through her mind.

She does not consider what it is or whether it can possibly be correct.

Entrusting everything to instinct alone—

“Aah—!”

—she drives every faculty she possesses toward that single possibility of victory.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa
”
She gulps.
There is a flash as small as a grain of sand.
She does not think about what it is, nor if it is correct.
She risks everything she has on her instinct.
“Ahh
!”
She charges at her “victory” with all her might.

pages.ja:
その姿を、架空の剣豪はどう取ったのか。
「
ク」
銀の鎧が、腕の隙間をすり抜けていく。
剣士の左腕下、腰と二の腕の間。
その、僅かばかりの隙間こそが、魔剣の死角だと彼女は見抜いたのか。
pages.jaRuby:
その姿を、架空の剣豪はどう取ったのか。
「
ク」
銀の鎧が、腕の隙間をすり抜けていく。
剣士の左腕下、腰と二の腕の間。
その、僅かばかりの隙間こそが、魔剣の死角だと彼女は見抜いたのか。
pages.en:
How does the imaginary master swordsman receive the sight?

“—Kh.”

Silver armor slips through the opening beneath his arm.

Below the swordsman’s left arm, between his waist and upper arm—

has she perceived that vanishingly narrow gap as the sorcerous blade’s sole blind spot?
pages.mirrorMoon:
What did the fictional swordsman think of that?
“
Kuh.”
Silver armor passes through the gap beside his arm.
The opening between the swordsman’s left arm and his waist.
Saber must have figured out that the small opening is the blind spot of the technique.

pages.ja:
セイバーは身を丸め、三つの刃で鎧を削がれながらも、その一点のみを突破した。
彼女の予知
卓越した直感があってこその妙技。
まだ見ぬ魔剣の完成形、不完全ながらも一度燕返しを体験したが故に、その完成図を予知し得た。
pages.jaRuby:
セイバーは身を丸め、三つの刃で鎧を削がれながらも、その一点のみを突破した。
彼女の予知
卓越した直感があってこその妙技。
まだ見ぬ魔剣の完成形、不完全ながらも一度燕返しを体験したが故に、その完成図を予知し得た。
pages.en:
Saber folds her body inward and breaks through that one point, though all three blades tear the armor from her.

It is a feat possible only because of her premonition—her transcendent instinct.

Having once experienced an incomplete Tsubame Gaeshi, she was able to foresee the completed form of a sorcerous blade she had never witnessed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Even though the attack still chips off her armor, Saber curls up and flies through the opening.
An exquisite skill that is only possible with her precognition
her great instinct.
She was able to predict the true Tsubame Gaeshi since she experienced it once.

pages.ja:
だが、驚嘆すべきはそんな事ではない。
彼女を生かしたのはその決意。
瞬間に浮かんだ閃きを信じ、刹那の隙間に全ての能力を傾けた。
通れる筈のない隙間、僅かでも遅ければ輪切りにされるという恐れを振り払って地を駆けた。
故に。
真実その決意こそが、かの魔剣を破り去った『強さ』だった。
pages.jaRuby:
だが、驚嘆すべきはそんな事ではない。
彼女を生かしたのはその決意。
瞬間に浮かんだ閃きを信じ、刹那の隙間に全ての能力を傾けた。

故に。
真実その決意こそが、かの魔剣を破り去った『強さ』だった。
pages.en:
—But that is not what merits wonder.

What preserves her life is her resolve.

She trusts the flash that came to her in that instant and commits every faculty to a momentary opening.

She races across the ground and casts aside the terror of a gap she should never have been able to pass, where the slightest delay would slice her into rings.

And thus—

that resolve, in truth, is the *strength* that shatters the sorcerous blade.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But that is not the surprising part.
It is her determination that kept her alive.
She trusted her insight and put all her power into the slight opening.
She shook off the fear that she would be slashed if she was even a moment late and charged into the small opening.
Therefore…
Her determination is the “strength” that defeated the demonic technique.

pages.ja:
「ア、はっ…………
！」
しかし、勝負はついていない。
燕返しを躱されたところで敵は真横、しかも剣士の抜刀を上回る速度での跳躍だ。
その体勢、容易に直せるものではない
！
pages.jaRuby:
「ア、はっ…………
！」
しかし、勝負はついていない。
燕返しを躱されたところで敵は真横、しかも剣士の抜刀を上回る速度での跳躍だ。
その体勢、容易に直せるものではない
！
pages.en:
“Ah—hah…!”

But the contest is not yet decided.

Even after evading Tsubame Gaeshi, the enemy remains directly beside her—and she leapt faster than the swordsman could draw.

She cannot readily recover from that posture—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ah, hah……
!”
But the match isn’t over yet.
Even though Tsubame Gaeshi was avoided, her enemy is right beside her, and she charged in with speed quicker than the attack.
It is not easy to recover her stance from such a charge
!

pages.ja:
「じゃっ
！」
長刀が翻る。
返す刃は魔剣に至らぬまでも最速。
だが。
振り払われた一撃は、僅かに剣士を上回っていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「じゃっ
！」
長刀が翻る。
返す刃は魔剣に至らぬまでも最速。
だが。
振り払われた一撃は、僅かに剣士を上回っていた。
pages.en:
“Hah—!”

The long blade wheels back.

Though the return stroke falls short of his sorcerous sword technique, it is as fast as he can make it.

But—

the blow Saber sweeps forth is faster by the narrowest margin.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ha
!”
The longsword strikes.
The attack is the quickest, even if it may not be as quick as the demonic technique.
But.
Her attack is a bit quicker than his.

pages.ja:
「ぐ
ぬ」
口元を締める。
堅く唇を閉ざし、倒れぬよう四肢に力を込める。
腑より逆流した血液が口内を満たしたが、決して吐き出すまいと飲み込んだ。
剣士の足下には、金の髪をした騎士がいる。
その輝きを五臓六腑の流しものなどで汚すなど、剣士の流儀には存在しない。
pages.jaRuby:
「ぐ
ぬ」
口元を締める。
堅く唇を閉ざし、倒れぬよう四肢に力を込める。
腑より逆流した血液が口内を満たしたが、決して吐き出すまいと飲み込んだ。

その輝きを[ruby text=ごぞうろっぷ char=4]五臓六腑の流しものなどで汚すなど、剣士の流儀には存在しない。
pages.en:
“Guh—”

He seals his mouth.

Pressing his lips firmly together, he puts strength into every limb so that he will not fall.

Blood surges up from his belly and fills his mouth, but he swallows it rather than allow a drop to escape.

—The golden-haired knight is at the swordsman’s feet.

To defile that radiance with the refuse of his own entrails would offend every principle by which he has lived.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Gu
nu.”
He closes his mouth.
He shuts his lips tight and tenses up so that he will not fall down.
Blood from his lungs fills his mouth, but he swallows it so that it will not spill out.
The golden-haired girl is below him.
The way of the swordsman does not allow him to dirty her with his blood.

pages.ja:
「
」
セイバーに言葉はない。
はらり、と金の髪が石段に舞っていく。
……首が付いている事が不思議だった。
……手足が削がれていない事は奇跡だった。
……あの僅かな隙間に身を投じた瞬間、体を四つに断ち切られたと実感した。
pages.jaRuby:
「
」
セイバーに言葉はない。
はらり、と金の髪が石段に舞っていく。
……首が付いている事が不思議だった。
……手足が削がれていない事は奇跡だった。
……あの僅かな隙間に身を投じた瞬間、体を四つに断ち切られたと実感した。
pages.en:
“——”

Saber has no words.

A lock of golden hair flutters down upon the stone steps.

…It is a wonder her head remains upon her shoulders.

…It is a miracle that her limbs have not been shorn away.

…The instant she hurled herself into that narrow opening, she was certain her body had been quartered.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
Saber does not say anything.
Her golden hair flutters down to the ground.
…It is a wonder that her head is still attached.
…It is a miracle that her limbs are still attached.
…She felt that her body would be slashed the instant she went into that opening.

pages.ja:
差があるとしたら、それだけの差だったのだ。
剣士の長刀。
それがたわんでいなかったのなら、彼の魔剣は生涯無敵であったろうに。
pages.jaRuby:
差があるとしたら、それだけの差だったのだ。
剣士の長刀。
それがたわんでいなかったのなら、彼の魔剣は生涯無敵であったろうに。
pages.en:
If there was a difference between them, it was no more than this:

the swordsman’s long blade.

Had it not been bent, his sorcerous sword would surely have remained invincible for the whole of his life.
pages.mirrorMoon:
That was the only difference.
The longsword…
The swordsman’s technique would have stayed invincible if his longsword had not been bent.

pages.ja:
大気が鳴動している。
山門の奥。境内では、異なる戦いが今も続いている。
「……………………」
セイバーは何を告げるべきか定まらず、死に体となった剣士を見上げた。
それに、
pages.jaRuby:
大気が鳴動している。
山門の奥。境内では、異なる戦いが今も続いている。
「……………………」
セイバーは何を告げるべきか定まらず、死に体となった剣士を見上げた。
それに、
pages.en:
—The air rumbles.

Beyond the gate, another battle continues within the temple grounds.

“…………”

Unable to decide what she ought to say, Saber looks up at the swordsman already beyond saving.

In answer—
pages.mirrorMoon:
The air is shaking.
Another battle is still going on behind the mountain gate.
“……”
Unsure of what to say, Saber looks up at the dying swordsman.
To that…

pages.ja:
「
行け」
視線を合わせる事なく剣士は告げた。
その言葉にどれだけの意味が込められていたのか。
セイバーは剣を引き抜き、全速で階段を駆け上がっていく。
立ちつくす剣士に振り返る事もない。
彼女はただ、己が役割を果たす為に駆けていった。
pages.jaRuby:
「
行け」
視線を合わせる事なく剣士は告げた。
その言葉にどれだけの意味が込められていたのか。
セイバーは剣を引き抜き、全速で階段を駆け上がっていく。
立ちつくす剣士に振り返る事もない。
彼女はただ、己が役割を果たす為に駆けていった。
pages.en:
“—Go.”

The swordsman speaks without meeting her eyes.

How much meaning lies within that single word?

Saber draws her blade free and races up the stairs at full speed.

She does not look back at the swordsman left standing behind her.

She runs only to fulfill her own role.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Go.”
The swordsman tells her without looking at her.
How much meaning was contained in that word?
Saber pulls out her sword and runs up the stairs.
She does not turn back to the swordsman.
She runs to fulfill her role.

pages.ja:
「ふ
美しい小鳥だと思ったのだがな。その実、獅子の類であった」
呟いて、それも当然、と剣士は笑った。
燕でさえ躱せぬものを躱したのだ。それが愛でるモノである筈がない。
pages.jaRuby:
「ふ
美しい小鳥だと思ったのだがな。その実、獅子の類であった」
呟いて、それも当然、と剣士は笑った。
燕でさえ躱せぬものを躱したのだ。それが愛でるモノである筈がない。
pages.en:
“Hah—I had taken her for a lovely little bird. In truth, she was more akin to a lion.”

The swordsman murmurs, then laughs as though the conclusion were inevitable.

She evaded a stroke that not even a swallow could escape. No such creature could be something merely to admire.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hah
I thought she was a beautiful bird, but she turned out to be a lion.”
He murmurs as if that was to be expected.
She avoided something that even a sparrow could not avoid, so she cannot be something that is admired.

pages.ja:
「
ふむ。女を見る目には自信があったのだが。どちらも修行不足という事か」
一人ごちて、剣士は肩を竦めた。
そのカタチ
雅な陣羽織は、既に色を失っている。
腹を突き破られ、鮮血に濡れた足下さえ希薄。
それを事も無げに見下ろし、さて、と石畳に腰を下ろす。
pages.jaRuby:
「
ふむ。女を見る目には自信があったのだが。どちらも修行不足という事か」

腹を突き破られ、鮮血に濡れた足下さえ希薄。
それを事も無げに見下ろし、さて、と石畳に腰を下ろす。
pages.en:
“—Hm. I had confidence in my eye for women. It seems I still lack training in more than one discipline.”

Speaking to himself, the swordsman shrugs.

His form—the elegant battle surcoat he wears—has already begun to lose its color.

His belly has been pierced, and even the feet drenched in fresh blood are fading.

He looks down upon them without concern, then lowers himself onto the paving stones.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Hm. I was confident in my skills to see through women. I guess I need more training in that as well.”
The swordsman complains with a shrug.
His elegant clothing has lost its colors already.
His stomach is pierced and his bloodstained feet are vague.
He looks down at them and sits.

pages.ja:
木々が揺れる。
山頂からの吹き下ろしが雑木林を揺らしていく。
花が散り鳥が消え風が止み、虚空の月さえ翳った頃。
そこにいた筈の剣士は、その存在自体が幻だったかのように、跡形もなく消え去っていた。

pages.en:
The trees sway.

Wind descends from the summit and passes through the thicket.

By the time the blossoms had scattered, the birds had vanished, the wind had fallen still, and even the moon in the empty heavens had grown dim—

the swordsman who should have been sitting there was gone without a trace, as though his very existence had been an illusion.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The branches shake.
The wind coming down from the top of the mountain rustles the forest.
And when the flowers scatter, the wind stops, and the moon darkens…
…The swordsman has disappeared without trace, as if his existence was just an illusion.
